item.title: The laboratory examination results: platelet, creatinine, and urea as predictors of mortality in Leptospirosis patients
item.description: Leptospirosis is a priority zoonotic disease in Indonesia and has the potential to cause outbreaks. The mortality rate of leptospirosis cases ranges from 5-20%. Predictors of mortality in leptospirosis include advanced age, oliguria, shortness of breath, icterus, thrombocytopenia, and elevated levels of potassium, creatinine, bilirubin, and urea. The purpose of this study was to analyze mortality predictor factors based on laboratory results in leptospirosis patients in Demak Regency, Indonesia.
